objections.statement: The preregistered placebo shifts the anchor window (1h bar containing 16:00 Europe/London) by +6h, landing on the 1h bar containing 22:00 Europe/London, and claims this is 'a time with no benchmark fixing and no rollover event'. Verified with zoneinfo: 22:00 London = 17:00 New York on 241 of 261 weekdays in 2025 (~92%), i.e. the placebo bar IS the New York 17:00 rollover bar - the single largest documented daily spread-widening/financing event, and precisely the event of this proposal's own variant B; on the remaining ~20 DST-gap days it is the hour immediately after the roll. The parenthetical arithmetic in the proposal ('...17:00 New York + 6h off-roll') is internally inconsistent, and under the only consistent reading the stated premise is false. Consequently the control does not destroy the mechanism; it swaps the fixing event for the rollover event, so 'placebo premium comparable to anchor demonstrates generic time-of-day drift' is an invalid interpretation, and falsification criterion (b) can fire (closing a genuine fixing premium) whenever a roll-hour premium exists. A required PLAN section 9 element (causal negative control) is invalid as specified. A7 does not repair proposals; as frozen, the objection is unresolvable, hence INELIGIBLE. A corrected fixing-window proposal would have to arrive as a new cycle input.
